node.title: Re: copy is not happening using
node.author: haukex
node.doctext: In addition to [Corion]'s [id://1217564|comments], note that [mod://Device::SerialPort] supports a "lookfor" method that can be used to "look for" certain strings like a command prompt and react to them. However, I would suggest you look at [mod://Expect] as an alternative, which can be used together with [mod://IO::Termios] instead of [mod://Device::SerialPort]. I wrote about this (with examples) in [id://1183290].
